_about: Public-domain Philip Skelton (1707-1787), Irish divine, rector of Fintona, for the Word Hoard: his Complete Works (London: R. Baynes, 1824, six volumes, with Burdy's Life; Deism Revealed, sermons and discourses), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 43 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
